name: Casares de las Hurdes (Spain)
description: White field with a red hoist stripe and a blue fly stripe, each accompanied by a thin stripe of the other colour, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Casares de las Hurdes (castles on red, a chequy field and a tree).
history: Municipal flag of Casares de las Hurdes; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Casares de las Hurdes arms — castles, chequy and tree
